description: Calculate an indicative price range (EUR incl. VAT) for a household move between two places in the EU, Switzerland or the UK. Uses truck road routing with real tolls, the vehicle needed for the volume and the loading/unloading crew. Returns low/high price, distance, vehicles, crew and a link where the user can request a binding fixed-price quote. Takes a few seconds. Does not create a booking.

destination.description: Destination city, postcode or street address

destination_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the destination, e.g. ES

language.description: Language of the matched addresses and the quote form

origin.description: Start city, postcode or street address, e.g. "Munich" or "10115 Berlin"

origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the start, e.g. DE

volume_m3.description: Volume in cubic metres. Typical: room 5, studio 10, 1-bed flat 15, 2–3 bed flat 25, house 50. Ask the user if unknown.

name: get_moving_estimate
title: Get a live moving price estimate
